findings.quote: The TTC recommends relocating the existing westbound stop at Fern Meadow Road to to the new proposed traffic control signals at Lawrence Avenue East and Valia Road/private driveway.
Construction of the McCowan Road Diversion and associated infrastructure on Metrolinx-owned property within the south-east corner of the intersection of McCowan Road and Lawrence Avenue East.

Metrolinx SSE - Long-term Temporary Road Closures and Public Highway Dedication Page 32 of 43 Stages 2 and 3: During Stages 2 and 3, construction activities will focus on the phased installation of temporary decking on Lawrence Avenue East, just west of its intersection with the McCowan Road diversion.
City Council prohibit stopping at all times on both sides of McCowan Road Diversion, between Lawrence Avenue East and a point 162 metres south, from October 1, 2025 to December 31, 2030, inclusive.
City Council designate a 40 km/h speed limit on McCowan Road Diversion, between Lawrence Avenue East and a point 162 metres south, from October 1, 2025 to December 31, 2030, inclusive.

City Council prohibit eastbound and westbound left-turns (emergency vehicles excepted) at all times at Lawrence Avenue East and McCowan Road/McCowan Road Diversion, from August 1, 2025 to January 31, 2027, inclusive.

Metrolinx SSE - Long-term Temporary Road Closures and Public Highway Dedication Page 31 of 43 The temporary lane closure impacts during various construction stages are discussed below: Auto Access Impacts Pre-Stage 1 works: Pre-Stage 1 works, expected to last approximately three months, will involve constructing the McCowan Road Diversion in the south-east quadrant of the intersection of Lawrence Avenue East and McCowan Road.

Stage 1 works: Stage 1 works, anticipated to last about one month, will involve shifting the intersection of Lawrence Avenue East and McCowan Road eastward and connecting it to the newly constructed McCowan Road Diversion.
A portion of the McCowan Road Diversion will traverse lands at 685-697 McCowan Road and 3091 Lawrence Avenue East, currently owned by Metrolinx.

TTC and Metrolinx will coordinate to ensure that relocated bus stops meets temporary bus stop design and placement criteria, ensuring passenger safety, accessibility, and convenience during construction.
findings.rule: relocated bus stops meets temporary bus stop

findings.quote: To facilitate the station box excavation and construction, a portion of McCowan Road at Lawrence Avenue will be temporarily diverted to the east.
